sloka: ते दृष्ट्वा राक्षसश्रेष्ठं वानराः पर्वतोपमम्।वायुनुन्ना इव घना ययुः सर्वा दिशस्तदा ।। ६.६५.५५ ।।
transliteration: te dṛṣṭvā rākṣasaśreṣṭhaṁ vānarāḥ parvatopamam।vāyununnā iva ghanā yayuḥ sarvā diśastadā ।। 6.65.55 ।।

translations.english: Heavy cloud like Kumbhakarna, a notorious one, perceiving the Vanara troops scattered like clouds in all directions emitted roar, laughing aloud.
